$comment: Screen reader procedure ledger (Issue #402). This file is the RECORD of the manual screen-reader review: for every operation a person has to perform with an assistive technology, it says what the operation is, which surface it happens on, which assistive technology and environment it has to be performed in, and what the announcement is expected to be. The gate (scripts/check-a11y-screenreader-steps.mjs) decides only whether the RECORD is intact - that every step is complete, that every step points at a surface that exists, and that no automated audit is passed off as a human screen-reader verification. The write-up is docs/verification/a11y/screenreader-steps.md.
policy: A screen-reader review is performed by a person with an assistive technology, and the record of that review is the observation a machine can never make. So the observation columns (observedAnnounce / performer / performedAt) stay EMPTY until a person fills them in, and an empty observation is not a violation: it is 'not-performed'. What the gate refuses is a record that is broken, that points at a surface that is gone, or that claims a screen-reader verification on the strength of an automated audit (the axe run of Issue #393 is a different thing and can never stand in for a person listening). A green run of this gate therefore means 'the ledger of the manual review is intact', never 'the site was read aloud and confirmed'.

assistiveTechnologies.description: macOS / iOS のスクリーンリーダー。Cmd+F5 で開始し、Ctrl+Option で読み上げる。
Windows のスクリーンリーダー。NVDA+Space で開始し、矢印キーで読み上げる。

subjects.description: 主要見出し。見出しのテキストとレベルが読み上げで判別できること。
操作名。リンク・ボタン・入力欄のアクセシブルな名前が読み上げで判別できること。
入力エラー。失敗の理由が入力項目と結びついて読み上げられること。

states.description: その surface が出荷状態のままのときの表示。
まだ何も入っていない状態の表示（未入力のフォーム）。
失敗した状態の表示（送信後の拒否、必須の欠落など）。
CSS 320 px 幅で Forced reflow を満たすときの表示。

surface.reproduce: src/home/hero.tsx の <h1 id="hero-title">（ビューポート 1280×720）

steps.expectedAnnounce: 「my-web-2026、見出しレベル 1」と読み上げられる（h1 のテキストは視覚的に隠されている）。
steps.observedAnnounce: 「my-web-2026、見出しレベル 1」と読み上げられた。

surface.reproduce: src/home/hero.tsx の <a href="/about">（ビューポート 1280×720）

steps.expectedAnnounce: 「About me / 自己紹介 →、リンク」と読み上げられる。
